filled_controls.M09.S1.baseline_value: Original 50 paired scenes: delayed software baseline accepted 10/50 (20%); map/transfer policy accepted 47/50 (94%). Final goal error: 1.358 +/- 1.161 m vs 0.218 +/- 0.536 m.
filled_controls.M09.S1.baseline_source: Actual MuJoCo benchmark/results.csv and benchmark/statistics.json; all 100 raw trials retained. This is a software-driver baseline, not a field or human baseline.
filled_controls.M09.S1.stakeholder: Potential inspection/response personnel and supervisors. Their present exposure, labor cost and workload were not measured; only the robot simulation and assumed economic scenario were evaluated.
filled_controls.M09.S2.timestep: 0.002 s (500 Hz physics and torque updates); 50 Hz state/CSV samples; 100 Hz wrench allocation, 10 Hz grid cost, 5 Hz planner requests.
filled_controls.M09.S2.friction: Robot geoms 1 / 0.01 / 0.001; floor sliding U(0.75,1.15), with 0.005 / 0.0001. Seed 42 floor coefficient 1.05958242. Rigid Coulomb-style contact; not a calibrated tire model.
filled_controls.M09.S2.solref: Robot 0.005 s / 1; floor 0.02 s / 1. At the evaluated settled contact, mixed solref is 0.0125 / 1. These are numerical settings, not measured material parameters; solimp defaults 0.9 / 0.95 / 0.001 / 0.5 / 2.
filled_controls.M09.S2.gains: Leg joint PD Kp=[500,800,800] N m/rad; Kd=[25,40,40] N m s/rad. Wheel roll gain 3 N m s/rad; brake Kp=60 and Kd=5. Leg limits 76.4 N m, hubs 21.6 N m. Wrench regularizer 1e-4. Analytic IK plus instantaneous stance wrench; no integral term or predictive horizon.
filled_controls.M09.S2.fsm_states: WAKEUP, DETOUR_NAV/CRUISE_MAP, DOCK_ALIGN; paired sequence listed above; CLEAR_REAR_EDGE, PLATEAU_RECON. Reasons include no_safe_path, obstacle_slow, obstacle_stop_replan and tilt_stop. See Annex A2 for transitions and gates.

filled_controls.M09.S4.baseline_condition: Delayed deterministic reactive software driver, same complete M20 and standing torque servo. No human operator, no measured NASA-TLX. Proposed policy bundles map planning and paired transfer; it is not a single-feature ablation.
filled_controls.M09.S4.n_runs: Original: 50 per policy (100 actual simulations). Avoidance extension: 12 per policy + two blocked fixtures. Combined: six shared and one illustrative baseline; descriptive only.
filled_controls.M09.S4.randomised: Original seeds 1000-1049; friction U(0.75,1.15), step U(0.055,0.085) m where used, barrier position/width and low rubble. Delays cycle 0.05/0.35/0.8/1.2 s. Combined course uses two fixed 8 cm rises and seeded friction/barrier offsets.
